item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence of military spending being used to enrich networks, reward security elites, intimidate neighbors, or project strength. I found no strong credible source showing a classic neighbor-intimidation campaign or a fully documented enrichment scheme via defense procurement in 2024. The available evidence is instead a mix of limited but real modernization, budget structure favoring operating costs over procurement, and conspicuous domestic militarization during the protest crisis.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh increases 2024–25 defence budget","publisher":"Janes","date":"June 6, 2024","url":"https://www.janes.com/defence-intelligence-insights/defence-news/industry/bangladesh-increases-202425-defence-budget","summary":"Bangladesh’s defense budget rose 11% to BDT423.6 billion, but Janes says development spending, including procurement, fell nearly 13% and overall modernisation had stalled under economic constraints. This is the strongest evidence that spending was not primarily a procurement-driven prestige buildup.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Bangladesh Army inducts new 300 mm MRLs","publisher":"Janes","date":"June 20, 2024","url":"https://www.janes.com/defence-intelligence-insights/defence-news/bangladesh-army-inducts-new-300-mm-mrls","summary":"The army inducted new Tiger T-300 multiple rocket launchers, and Hasina described the system as adding “a new dimension” to the army’s capabilities. This is evidence of real hardware modernisation, though it also has a show-of-strength element.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Inauguration of Bangabandhu Basic Trainer (BBT)","publisher":"Inter-Services Public Relations, Bangladesh Air Force","date":"March 24, 2024","url":"https://ispr.gov.bd/en/innauguration-of-bangabandhu-basic-trainer-bbt/","summary":"Hasina officially inaugurated the first Bangabandhu Basic Trainer aircraft, presented as an indigenous aviation capability and training platform. This is a genuine capacity-building investment, not just patronage spending.","question_ids":["2B.8","1B.7","1B.3"]},{"title":"Command Safety Seminar-2024 of Bangladesh Air Force Held","publisher":"Inter-Services Public Relations, Bangladesh Air Force","date":"April 30, 2024","url":"https://ispr.gov.bd/en/command-safety-seminar-2024-of-bangladesh-air-force-held/","summary":"The Air Force emphasized safety, training, and “22,929 safe flying hours.” This is positive evidence that part of the force was oriented toward operational safety and real readiness.","question_ids":["2B.8","1B.7","1B.3"]},{"title":"Bangladesh Army officers and corps annual conferences","publisher":"Inter-Services Public Relations","date":"June 12, 2024 and November 7, 2024","url":"https://ispr.gov.bd/%E0%A6%B8%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B9%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%A8%E0%A7%80-%E0%A6%AA%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%A7%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%95%E0%A7%87-%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%A6%E0%A6%BE%E2%80%8C/","summary":"Army corps ceremonies in 2024 continued a visible modernization and organisational rhythm under the service chief. This supports the existence of mobilization and capability management, though the evidence is ceremonial rather than budgetary.","question_ids":["2B.8","1B.7"]},{"title":"Bangladesh army chief inspects deployed troops","publisher":"Inter-Services Public Relations","date":"July 24, 2024","url":"https://ispr.gov.bd/%E0%A6%AE%E0%A7%8B%E0%A6%A4%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AF%E0%A6%BC%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%A4-%E0%A6%B8%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B8%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%AF%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%B0/","summary":"The army chief inspected troops deployed in districts during the protest crisis. That is mobilization, but in a domestic order-maintenance role rather than external deterrence.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.4","2B.5","1B.8"]},{"title":"Bangladesh army refused to suppress protest, sealing Hasina's fate","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 6, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusivebangladesh-army-refused-to-suppress-protest-sealing-hasinas-fate-3558302","summary":"Reuters reported the army would not fire on civilians to enforce the curfew. This undercuts any claim that military mobilization was being used for legitimate external security and shows the coercive edge of the force was being pushed toward regime survival.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.4","2B.5","1B.8"]},{"title":"Bangladesh army enforces curfew as student-led protests spiral","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Reuters described a nationwide curfew and internet/text shutdowns as the government escalated. This is the clearest evidence of mobilization being used to intimidate domestic opponents rather than meet external security needs.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.4","2B.5","1B.8"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-calm-a-day-after-top-court-scrapped-some-job-quotas-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence. That is more consistent with projecting personal strength and preserving power than with a narrowly defined security rationale.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.4","2B.5","1B.8"]},{"title":"Bangladesh: Türk decries government crackdown, urges respect for international human rights standards","publisher":"United Nations / OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said more than 170 people had been killed and that shutdowns increase impunity. This is strong external evidence that the mobilized force package was abusive rather than security-efficient.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.4","2B.5","1B.8"]}]}
